concerns.text: FR-013 (final report) cites '*(See US-03 AC5)*' but US-03 has only four acceptance criteria (AC1–AC4), and no user story's scope covers a final report artifact. Re-anchor FR-013 to a real story/AC (e.g., extend US-03 or add a reporting story) or remove the dangling citation.

FR-014 (novel-log corpus acquisition, ≥500 post-2025 GitHub-issue logs) is anchored only to '*(Scope requirement from idea)*' — no user story covers data acquisition. Add a data-acquisition user story (or fold corpus acquisition into US-01's scope) so FR-014 traces to a story rather than only to the idea document.
